newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Celestial started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Celestial started as buy.

text.p: -- Stephens Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Celestial Seasonings Inc with a strong buy recommendation.
-- It established a $30 price target for the stock of Celestial, a dominant brand in the herbal tea category.

-- "With earnings expected to grow at a compounded rate of 19.8 percent over the next two years, Celestial is attractive at only 12x our 1998 earnings estimate of $1.75 per share," analyst R. Shane Glenn noted in a report.
